subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should Android maintainers adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109433 as the canonical Wear companion after it gains exact-head physical proof, or continue this contributor branch as the landing path?
rationale: Two substantial branches now implement the same product surface, and selecting the permanent runtime, security, and Android release owner boundary cannot be resolved by a mechanical patch review.

options.title: Canonicalize the owner branch
options.body: Require exact-head physical conversation, session, voice, and TTS proof on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109433, then close this PR as superseded while retaining its contributor credit and evidence.

options.title: Continue this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing candidate, replace canonical session keys with phone-side opaque handles, refresh exact-head hardware proof, and close the competing implementation.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize the owner branch
recommendation.body: Require exact-head physical conversation, session, voice, and TTS proof on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109433, then close this PR as superseded while retaining its contributor credit and evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Android runtime, user experience, phone/watch trust boundaries, and release operations, matching the documented Android contribution ownership.
